//: Aliran service descriptor. Either bake this into the build (build-time config) or deliver it to the app at runtime via a QR/deep link so one generic APK can connect to any operator's panel.
name: My Aliran Service
//dev: Optional local-dev block (auto-login for the worklet smoke test): "dev": { "username": "...", "password": "..." }. Never include it in a shipped descriptor.
//vod: Optional external VOD provider block. The provider's COORDINATES (apiBase / service / sources / params) are NEVER configured here - they come from the operator's panel at login, and the Movies & Series section only exists while the panel has a provider enabled. The only thing this block may carry is a DEV credential override, below.

vod._comment: DEV ONLY. In production the app passes the VIEWER's own app username and password to the provider, so no credential belongs in a descriptor. Fill this in only in a LOCAL, GITIGNORED config/service.json when testing against a provider account that is not a viewer account, and NEVER ship a build whose descriptor contains it (public builds especially - the file is baked into the APK).
